name: Menu & options plus
description: Main menu layout (order, hidden commands, extra entries that run a common event or open a scene), Skills/Equip/Status without choosing an actor when the party has one member, and extra rows on the options screen.

settings_schema.label: Command order
settings_schema.help: Command IDs listed first, in this order; the others follow. Built-in IDs: item, skill, equip, status, options, save, game_end; extra entries use their own ID.

settings_schema.label: Hidden commands
settings_schema.help: Command IDs that are not shown.

settings_schema.label: Extra menu entries
settings_schema.help: Each entry runs a common event (the menu closes first) or opens a scene over the menu.

item_fields.label: Shown only while switch is ON
Usable only while switch is ON

settings_schema.label: Party of one: skip choosing the actor
settings_schema.help: Skills, Equip and Status open for the only party member straight away.

settings_schema.label: Extra option rows
settings_schema.help: Rows added to the options screen. The player's choice is saved with the options; it can also be copied into a switch (on/off rows) or a variable (other rows) when the game starts or the value changes.
